title: Ambassador Program
description: Join the volunteer corps on a mission to spark curiosity, build community, and inspire confidence.

title: Ambassador
Program
hero.pinAlt: The ambassador pin, floating and catching the light
hero.lede: Join the volunteer corps on a mission to spark curiosity, build community, and inspire confidence.

mission.title: Spark curiosity.
mission.alt: Teal cat-eye enamel glowing into ink, with fine teal glitter

mission.title: Build community.
mission.alt: A raised nickel line tracing the swoosh over red enamel

mission.title: Inspire confidence.
mission.alt: Red cat-eye enamel with fine red glitter

you.title: It starts with you.
you.lede: You'll give some of your time. It gives back in three ways at once.

items.label: As a person
items.title: Confidence you earn by doing.
items.body: You'll tell your story, hold a room, and learn more by teaching than you ever did alone.

items.label: As a citizen
items.title: A real say in what your community builds.
items.body: You'll listen to your neighbors and bring their voices into the problems The Labs takes on.

items.label: As a professional
items.title: Skills that travel, and proof with your name on it.
items.body: Storytelling, facilitation, community building, and discovery, practiced for real.

labs.title: Three habits run everything we do.
labs.lede: The Upskilling Labs is free, runs on volunteers, and started at DC Public Library in fall 2025.

habits.title: We decide together.
habits.body: In every Build Cycle, participants choose the problems The Labs takes on. Everyone gets a vote.

habits.title: We learn by building.
habits.body: Small teams make something real and lasting in response to a real problem.

habits.title: We pass it on.
habits.body: Everyone shares what they learn as they go, because teaching is the best way to learn.

ripple.title: Then it spreads.

rings.title: You
rings.body: You learn to tell your story, hold a room, and bring someone new along.

rings.title: Someone you know
rings.body: One conversation, and their next chapter starts.

rings.title: Your community
rings.body: Their Pod picks a problem your neighbors actually have, and builds something that lasts.

rings.title: Everyone
rings.body: Picture that in every neighborhood. The future gets built either way. This is how everyone gets a hand in it.

ripple.note: America's first lending library started with a dozen neighbors who met to teach each other. The Labs started inside a library.
ripple.videoLabel: A small planet with teal and red glows at the centre of nickel orbits. Swoosh-shaped craft circle it, one on the first orbit, more on each one after, and a pulse of light spreads out past them all.

team.title: Every conversation is research.
team.lede: You're not just spreading the word. You're part of the team figuring out how communities grow. What you hear helps shape the problems The Labs takes on. What you learn becomes the playbook every Labs project uses to grow its own community.

roles.title: Talk to people.
roles.body: One-on-one, no script. Ask what they're working toward, and really listen.

roles.title: Take the mic.
roles.body: Tell a room about The Labs at community events. You won't be winging it.

roles.title: Share your link.
roles.body: You get a personal referral link. Everyone who joins The Labs through it counts.

roles.title: Bring someone along.
roles.body: Mentor a new ambassador through initiation. It's how the corps grows.

title: The button says you're in.
The pin says you passed it on.

steps.title: Get initiated.
steps.body: Watch a video or two and pass a short quiz. The button is yours.

steps.title: Do the work.
steps.body: [N] new upskillers join The Labs through your link, and you give one talk to a room.

steps.title: Mentor someone.
steps.body: Bring one new ambassador through initiation. Now you're a Mentor, and the pin is yours.

rewards.title: The button
rewards.body: A video, a quiz, and you're in. It's how people spot an ambassador, and how you'll spot each other.
rewards.alt: The ambassador button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and AMBASSADOR in white

rewards.title: The pin
rewards.body: [N] new upskillers, one talk to a room, one new ambassador. You can't buy one.
rewards.alt: The Mentor pin: the orb mark in polished nickel with teal and red cat-eye enamel

goal.title: Here's what we're going for.
goal.meterLabel: New upskillers adding up toward the goal
goal.note: That's about two new upskillers a week for each ambassador, as long as the corps keeps growing. Which is exactly what Mentors are for. Nobody carries this alone.

quote.text: I came to one workshop for myself. Now the best part is watching someone I brought in find their team.
quote.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Founding ambassador

join.title: Come be an ambassador.
join.lede: Initiation takes a video or two and a short quiz. The rest, we'll figure out together.

footer.guide: Already an ambassador? Open the guide

items.a: No. Being an ambassador is free, and so is The Labs: workshops and Build Cycles cost nothing.

items.q: How much time does it take?
items.a: Initiation takes a video or two and a short quiz. After that it's up to you: most of it is conversations you'd have anyway, plus one talk to a room. [PLACEHOLDER: add a typical hours-per-month figure.]

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. You need to be curious about people and willing to tell your own story. The guide walks you through the rest.

items.q: What's the difference between the button and the pin?
items.a: The button is yours at initiation. It says you're in. The pin is for Mentors: [N] new upskillers through your link, one talk to a room, and one new ambassador brought through initiation. You can't buy one.
Yes, any time. Tell your coordinator, and you're always welcome back.
Your ambassador coordinator. Their contact is in the guide, and they reply within two working days. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm the coordinator's details.]

items.label: What you commit to
items.title: A few conversations and one talk.
items.body: Tell your story, invite people you know, and give one short talk to a room. [PLACEHOLDER: add expected hours per month.]

items.label: Who can join
items.title: Anyone who wants others to find The Labs.
items.body: You don't need to be technical or an expert. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm eligibility, e.g. you've been to a workshop or Build Cycle.]

items.label: What happens next
items.title: A video, a quiz, the button.
items.body: Raise your hand, pass initiation, and your button is on its way. The guide takes it from there.
